preconditions.description: The length of the text string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of the pattern string pat is between 1 and the length of S.
Both S and pat are strings.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of integers
postconditions.description: The output is a list of integers representing the starting indices of all occurrences of pat in S, starting from 1.

postconditions.expression: output is empty if pat is not a substring of S
postconditions.description: If pat is not a substring of S, the output is an empty list.

postconditions.expression: output[i] >= 1 for all i in range(len(output))
postconditions.description: Each index in the output list is a 1-based index where pat starts in S.
